newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa quietly mixed at noon.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa quietly mixed at noon.

text.p: Cocoa futures were tightly mixed at midesssion on Tuesday after drifting in a narrow range.
Traders said benchmark September saw some support at 1,027-1,028 stg, the session's lows, and bounced back to end midday unchanged at 1,033 stg a tonne on light short-covering.
It hit a high of 1,037. "There was a lack of volume and people expect the market to weaken by itself," said one trader. "It found support at 1,027-1,028 and it was bid up again."
Volume totalled just 635 lots at midday, centred on September contract.
They called New York to open unchanged to slightly higher.
There were no fresh fundamental news.
Technically, traders said the market was probably near its immediate bottom after the recent sharp retracement from the July 1 peak of 1,170.
The next key support after 1,027 lies at 1,000 stg, the bottom of the current range.

While there was a dearth of supply/demand news, cocoa's downward drift in the past sessions was also aided by sterling's jump against German mark and other major currencies. --Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
